title: Generate cinematic long takes up to 30 seconds in a single Seedance 2.5…
content:
Generate cinematic long takes up to 30 seconds in a single Seedance 2.5 generation to create longer scenes with better consistency and smoother motion.  
Use Seedance 2.5 timestamp control to specify exactly when actions, camera movements, or lighting changes occur throughout the video.  
Test your prompts with reference inputs in Seedance 2.5 to increase control and make longer, more complex scenes easier to create.
